title: Hummingbird Ka Dil Kitna Tez Dhadakta Hai? 🐦 #shorts
idea: A hummingbird's heart can beat up to 1,260 beats per minute, burning massive energy compared to humans.

lines.text: Hummingbird ka dil ek minute mein 1,260 baar dhadak sakta hai!
Ek insaan ka dil rest par sirf 70 baar dhadakta hai.
Yani ye nanhi chidiya har second 21 baar dhadakti hai!
Iske pankh bhi ek second mein 99 baar phadphadate hain!
Ye chidiya ek marathon runner se 10 guna zyada energy kharch karti hai!
Kya aapka dil kabhi itna tez dhadka hai? Comment mein batao!

youtube.title: Hummingbird Ka Dil Kitna Tez Dhadakta Hai? 🐦 #shorts
youtube.description:
Kya aapko pata hai ki hummingbird ka dil 1 minute mein 1,260 baar dhadak sakta hai? Jaaniye is choti chidiya ke baare mein mind-blowing facts!

#hummingbird #facts #mindblowingfacts #hinglish #shorts

facts.claim: The heart rate of hummingbirds can reach as high as 1,260 beats per minute.
Hummingbird wing-beat frequency can reach 99 per second.
Hummingbirds expend 10 times the energy of a marathon runner.
